 Print CBSE Date Sheet 2027 expected soon: Check how to download Class 10 and 12 timetable CBSE Date Sheet 2027 : The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is expected to release the date sheet for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027 soon. Students appearing for the 2026-27 academic session will be able to check and download the subject-wise timetable from the official website, cbse.gov.in, once it is published. The main board examinations are expected to begin in February 2027. Students across India and abroad are awaiting the examination schedule to plan their revision and preparation. Class 10 students will have a two-examination system, while Class 12 students will appear for their scheduled board examinations. CBSE has not yet confirmed the date sheet release date in the information available. How to download CBSE Date Sheet 2027
 Once released, students can follow these steps to access the timetable: Step 1: Visit the official website, cbse.gov.in. Step 2: Click on the ‘Main Website’ link. Step 3: Find the latest notification for the CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Date Sheet 2027. Step 4: Open the relevant link to view the subject-wise timetable in PDF format. Step 5: Download and save the PDF for future reference. Details mentioned in the date sheet The CBSE date sheet PDF is expected to contain subject-wise examination dates, exam-day instructions, examination timings and the day of each paper. Students should verify the details carefully after downloading the document. Check sample papers and passing criteria While waiting for the timetable, students can access sample question papers and other preparation resources through the CBSE academic website. These materials can help them understand the examination pattern and practise subject-wise questions. Students generally need to secure at least 33% marks in each subject to pass the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations, subject to the board's applicable assessment and passing rules. CBSE has introduced changes to its examination and evaluation processes in recent years. The two-examination system for Class 10 provides students with an opportunity to improve their performance, while on-screen marking for Class 12 supports digital evaluation. Students are advised to check the official CBSE website regularly for the confirmed date sheet and further examination announcements.
